findings.title: Invalidate connected calendars after deleting cached data
findings.body: The delete-cache success handler only invokes the optional onSuccess callback; it never invalidates the connectedCalendars query that supplies cacheUpdatedAt. SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper passes through an optional onChanged callback and does not refetch this query itself, so deleting the cache can leave the old timestamp and delete action visible after a success toast. Window-focus refetching is also explicitly disabled in that wrapper. Invalidate utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars on successful deletion, as the disconnect mutation already does, so the displayed status reflects the deletion without a page reload.
